newsitem.title: FRANCE: CDC bank revises French Q2 growth forecast down.
newsitem.headline: CDC bank revises French Q2 growth forecast down.

text.p: State bank Caisse des Depots et Consignations said on Monday it had revised downwards its growth forecast for the second quarter due to a slowdown in industrial production and consumption but it was more optimistic for the third quarter.

It forecast growth of 0.5 percent in the second quarter, compared to an earlier forecast of 0.7 percent. GDP growth was 0.2 percent in the first quarter and national statistics office INSEE is forecasting expansion of 1.2 percent in the second quarter.

CDC said elections in June had contributed to the slowdown and forecast stronger growth in the third quarter, helped by foreign trade and favourable exchange rates. The dollar has appreciated some 20 percent against the franc since January.

It revised upwards its third quarter forecast to 0.7 percent from 0.5 percent previously and forecast 0.5 percent growth in the fourth quarter. The government is forecasting growth of 2.3 percent this year.
Last week economic research group GAMA said growth would be between 1.8 and 1.9 percent this year. It said this would weigh on tax receipts and on the governement's deficit-cutting efforts.
